page.layout: One column of text on the page, centred; below it a woodcut ornament; a catchword-like signature "IGNIS." at the lower right. No margin notes. Running head at the top.

main_text.p: TRANSEUNTEM hospitio excipere, magna est comitas.

HOSPES nullus tàm in amici hospitium divorti potest,
Quin ubi triduum continuum fuerit, jam odiosus fiet.
Verùm ubi dies decem continuos ire ad eundem instat,
Tametsi dominus non invitus patitur, servi murmurant.
HOSPITEM peregrinum non decet esse importunum in alienâ domo.
In bono hospite, atq; amico quæstus est, quod sumitur.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament below the text, no text. Catchword-like word "IGNIS." at the lower right is taken as a signature/catchword. Abbreviation "atq;" kept as printed. Some lines are set in small capitals for initial words (TRANSEUNTEM, HOSPES, HOSPITEM), rendered in plain capitals.
